parole.significato: mortar (vessel used to grind ingredients, especially spices or pharmaceutical preparations)
parole.testo: From Byzantine Greek γδί(ν) (gdí(n)), from Koine Greek ἰγδίον (igdíon), diminutive of Ancient Greek ἴγδις (ígdis), of Pre-Greek origin (evidenced by cluster "-γδ-" per Beekes).
